duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I perform ruqya (healing prayer) upon you from everything that harms you
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi arqika min kulli shay'in yu'dhika

duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. I rely upon Him
duas.transliteration: Hasbi Allah la ilaha illa hu, alayhi tawakaltu

duas.arabic: الحمد لله الذي بنعمته تتم الصالحات
duas.english: All praise is due to Allah by whose favor good deeds are completed
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lilahi alladhi bini'matihi tatimmu as-salihaat

duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and turn to me in mercy. Indeed, You are the Ever-Returning, the Merciful
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa tub alayya innaka anta at-tawwabu ar-rahim

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
duas.english: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease for me my task
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inshrah li sadri wa yassir li amri

duas.english: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.english: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanah wa fi al-akhirah hasanah wa qina adha ab-nar

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي آيَةً وَاجْعَلْهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, give me a blessed offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication
duas.transliteration: Rabbi j'al li ayatan wa'j'alhu min as-saliheen

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of the merciful
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir wa arham wa anta khayru ar-rahimeen

duas.english: O Most Merciful of the Merciful
My Lord, increase me in knowledge
